# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_WICK_BOUNCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The EMA ribbon (8,20,50) acts as dynamic support in uptrends. A decisive rejection wick piercing below the 20-EMA but closing back above the 8-EMA on elevated volume indicates latent buying pressure and a high-probability bounce. This setup captures the sharp rejection bounce distinct from a simple reclaim of the ribbon.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When the 5-minute candle's low penetrates below the 20-EMA by at least 0.1% of SPY price, the candle's close is above the 8-EMA, and volume > 1.3× the 20-period average volume, go long at the close of that candle.  
**Exit:** Initial stop: chart-stop just below the low of the entry candle. TP1: 1.5× risk (risk = entry price - stop price). After TP1 is hit, trail the runner with a chandelier exit (ATR×3).  
**Regime filters:** Only trade when VIX < 18, time between 09:30-11:30 ET, and the ribbon is aligned (8-EMA > 20-EMA > 50-EMA).
